svg.aria-label: How to make a Bloody Mary, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add the vodka, tomato juice, lemon juice and horseradish to your shaker. Season it. Worcestershire, Tabasco, a pinch of salt and a grind of pepper. Shake. Add ice and shake hard, until frosty cold. Pour it all in. Pour everything, ice and all, into a tall glass. Garnish. A celery stalk and a lemon wedge. Cheers!
